real_qa.q: How did Clayton Turner become Director of NASA Langley Research Center?
real_qa.r: After graduating high school, Turner initially struggled in college, spent three years in the Army, then worked repairing pinball machines and video games before working at Dynamic Recording Studio in Rochester, New York. While in Rochester during a blizzard, he decided to return to college with greater motivation. Upon graduation, he received a call on his birthday from someone inviting him to interview at NASA Langley Research Center, where he was born on Langley Air Force Base. The combination of mentorship and guided opportunities throughout his career—rather than a deliberate plan to become center director—led him to progressively take on roles as engineer, chief engineer, director of engineering, and eventually associate director before becoming center director.
